Based on the visual evidence in the image:

(1) **Yes, the entire card is visible.** The "Hot Drinks" overlay card is fully contained within the phone screen boundaries. You can see its complete right edge, rounded corners, and the content inside (including the number '4' on the far right).

(2) **Yes, it aligns with the pills below.** The right edge of the expanded "Hot Drinks" card roughly aligns with the right edges of the category pills below it (Category 2, Category 3, etc.). The card appears to expand primarily to the left from its original position, maintaining its right-side alignment while widening to show more content.

(3) **No, it does not extend beyond the screen.** The card is fully visible and does not clip or overflow off the right side of the display.
